What does your next dollar of profit actually cost you in tax?

2026–27 resident rates: the first $18,200 is tax-free, then 15% to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000 and 45% above that, plus the 2% Medicare levy for most people. As a sole trader, your business profit is taxed at your personal rate.

The higher your rate, the more each legal deduction is worth: $1,000 of deductions saves $320 at 30% plus Medicare, $470 at 45% plus Medicare.

Save this.

General info only, not personal advice.
